# LSJ — παράδειγμα / παραδείκνυμι

## Source identity

This source house records two related LSJ entries as served by the Scaife ATLAS digital lexicon. It is used narrowly to discipline the essay's authorial development of **paradigm**. The lexical history does not prove the essay's metaphysics or Epi-Logos architecture.

## Relevant lexical field

The LSJ entry for **παράδειγμα** gives the primary sense **pattern, model**, with examples including an architect's model or plan, an artistic model, Platonic exemplars and the relation between exemplar and image. The headword is derived there from **παραδείκνυμι**.

The LSJ entry for **παραδείκνυμι** gives **exhibit side by side** as its leading sense, extending to **make comparisons**, **compare**, **indicate**, **point out**, **exhibit / bring forward**, and **represent**.

These senses matter because the authorial paradigm development concerns a lived pattern becoming explicitly comparable with its own articulated model. The lexical relation is suggestive and exact at the level of Greek usage; the philosophical inference remains Taylor's.

## Essay use

### Licensed use

- Use *paradeigma* to retain **pattern / model / exemplar** rather than reducing “paradigm” to an abstract belief-set.
- Use *paradeiknumi* to note the lexical force of **exhibiting side by side / comparing** when explaining why an enacted paradigm can become inspectable through an explicit articulation of its own pattern.
- Keep the operation distinct from claiming that ancient Greek usage already contained the essay's theory of Objective Internality or reflexive AI systems.

### Claim boundary

This lexicon does not establish that Objective Internality is the historical meaning of *paradeigma*, nor that Epi-Logos is etymologically derived from it. The relation is **Argued / Resonant with**: an authorial philosophical development uses the lexical field to sharpen what it means for a lived world-structure to become modelled alongside its own enactment.

<a id="passages"></a>
## Passage / entry register

- **παράδειγμα** — LSJ short definition: pattern; senses include pattern/model and exemplar.
- **παραδείκνυμι** — LSJ short definition: exhibit side by side; senses include comparison, indication and representation.

No extended LSJ wording is admitted as a quotation in manuscript prose through this record; paraphrase the lexical senses and cite the digital entry if needed.

**Reader return:** paradigm first becomes explicit in the linear argument at [[section-rooms/01-differentiating-mind/movements/12-s0-p5-objective-internality|M12 — Objective Internality]].
